description_en: The Chorten might date from the time when Junbesi was settled in the mid 16th century, however, no concrete information is available regarding the chorten's original shape and time of construction. It certainly was originally built out of roughly hewn rock similar to many surviving examples found in the region. Sometimes in the 1990s the Chorten was restored with heavy layers of cement plaster giving it todays shape. No historic photographs could be located.
description_ne: यो छोर्तेन् जुनबेँसी आवादी हुँदा ईशाको सोह्रौं शताब्दीतिर बनाइएको हुनुपर्दछ । तर यो कुरा किटेरै भन्न सकिने कुनै प्रमाण भने उपलब्ध छैन । यस क्षेत्रमा अझैसम्म बाँकि रहेका अरु सम्पदाहरूमा प्रयोग गरिएका जस्तै ढुङ्गाविशेष प्रयोग गरेर यो छोर्तेन बनाएको कुरामा भने कुनै शङ्का छैन । सन् १९९० को दशकमा सिमेण्ट प्रयोग गरी पुनर्निर्माणको क्रममा यो छोर्तेन्लाई वर्तमान आकार दिइएको हो ।  यो सम्पदाको कुनै पनि ऐतिहासिक चित्र उपलब्ध हुन सकेन ।

historical_events.event_description: In April 2021 construction of a new library buiding was started. The project is managed and financed by the INGO Read Nepal.While installing the heavy concrete foundations, it was discovered that the drawings did not specify the exact location and elevation of the building.Community members became aware that ground floor windows would be located below ground. Concerns were also raised regarding the building's disproportional size and lack of a sensitive design fitting the historic setting.The project was stopped and is currently under review. Communiy representatives requested the donor to develop a more traditional design.
